purpose: Use synthetic evaluators aggressively for defect discovery and release vetoes without pretending their votes estimate human-population preference.

candidate_binding.product_digest_scope: deterministic public/ tree after canonical build; review-receipt-only commits may follow without invalidating the reviewed product

critical_criteria.statement: On normal-motion English rich pages, autonomous background/hero motion is visibly perceptible within two seconds without pointer input.
Horizontal and vertical pointer motion produce obvious, directionally distinguishable deformation on home and at least one non-home rich English page.
The intended site-wide moving background remains visually exposed through the final composited page rather than being hidden by opaque surfaces.
Exactly one authoritative motion controller owns each moving surface, clock, pointer state, pause state and reduced-motion state; no competing writer can clear or replace the same render target.
Body, metadata and labels remain optically legible and crisp at 100%, 125%, 150%, mobile DPR, and fallback-font states; decorative microtype may not masquerade as readable UI text.
The language selector has a deliberate complete visual boundary or an explicitly open editorial treatment; it must not read as accidentally clipped or unfinished.
A blind first-impression reviewer, shown only the rendered product, does not describe the site as static, broken, unfinished, illegible, or debug-like on any flagship page.
A hostile evaluator cannot exhibit a concrete implementation or observation where all machine predicates pass while the user-facing requirement is materially false.
At normal viewing sizes the site reads as deliberate, finished and visually hierarchical rather than clipped, debug-like, over-microtyped or accidentally composed.
A cold visitor can identify the project purpose and reach a meaningful next action or contribution/frontier path without prior explanation.
Keyboard, 200% zoom/reflow and reduced-motion modes preserve primary task operability, focus visibility, legibility and intentional composition.
Representative mobile and constrained-device views remain legible, scrollable, responsive and visually intentional with no hidden primary affordances or severe jank.
Motion and graphics are visibly labeled and composed so they cannot reasonably be mistaken for stronger quantitative simulation, proof or scientific evidence than the project actually has.
Reduced-motion, no-JS and renderer-failure modes remain intentional visual compositions with equivalent informational hierarchy rather than emergency placeholders.
Typography remains crisp and legible under representative browser/scaling/fallback-font conditions; font loading failure cannot turn interface text into broken microtype.

release_rule: Every critical criterion must have its required evidence modalities and reviewer coverage. Any P0/P1 veto, missing evidence, missing review, or unresolved contradiction blocks release. No average, majority, or Pareto score can override this rule.
